scope: PR #181 (~16 files): a Flesch-Kincaid readability.mjs reference script + reading-grade rule in usability-ux-universal-design; an EVIDENCE-WORDS claim-lint rule + evidence-discipline section 8 in skeptical-audit; 2 BDD scenarios + step defs + datastore; tests; ADR-0094; CHANGELOG. The review passed the mechanical gate and found boundary/ownership/dependency clean, but raised three violations (and two minor items) against the four questions; all five were fixed before this entry.

boundary.evidence: reading grade is a plain-language concern, so the script lives in usability-ux (ADR-0094 records the split).

ownership.evidence: the reading-grade rule has one owner here; the evidence-words rule is owned by skeptical-audit and only cross-referenced.

dependency.evidence: Node built-ins only (node:fs); no outbound web (arch gate confirms).

error-handling.evidence: fail-closed (exit 2) on no countable prose, empty/unreadable file, a non-numeric target, AND (F2 fix) a missing --max-grade value or empty --max-grade=; a draft with no grade and a gate with no target are never a silent pass. Regression tests added.

boundary.evidence: the EVIDENCE-WORDS rule extends the single-purpose report linter; no new boundary.

ownership.evidence: skeptical-audit owns the evidence discipline; the rule is documented once in evidence-discipline section 8.

dependency.evidence: Node built-ins only; no outbound web.

error-handling.evidence: fail-closed behavior unchanged. F1 fix: the rule now requires NUMERIC framing and SAME-LINE co-occurrence of the chosen-set and framing signals, so common bare nouns (attempts, error rate, probability) and unrelated adjacent sentences are no longer flagged. F3 fix: RANDOM_SET is affirmative-only (dead 'no random' branch removed), so 'no randomness' no longer disarms a deterministic-set slip. Four co-occurrence no-FP tests plus a deterministic-set must-flag test added.

boundary.evidence: integration tests; spawn the real scripts.

error-handling.evidence: each rule/behavior has bad-flags + good-passes cases plus the no-FP guards the review found; a no-op flips the must-flag cases. claim-lint 43/43, readability 14/14.

boundary.evidence: the two operator scenarios drive the real readability.mjs and claim-lint.mjs, so they are integration tests, not restatements.

dependency.evidence: Node built-ins; spawns the real scripts.

error-handling.evidence: assertions throw on a wrong exit; F-minor-b fix: the vacuous constant-vs-regex assertion was removed, leaving the real lint-run as the load-bearing check. 13/13 scenarios pass.

boundary.evidence: documentation of the two rules and the ownership split.

ownership.evidence: one owner each; cross-referenced, not duplicated.

error-handling.evidence: F-minor-a fix: the ADR, CHANGELOG, evidence contract, and claim-lint comment were trimmed to match the tightened behavior (numeric + same-line; fails closed on a missing or non-numeric target); the teaching examples were reworded so they no longer self-flag the EVIDENCE-WORDS rule.

findings.finding: cry-wolf: realistic correct sentences were flagged (bare 'attempts'/'error rate'/'probability', and a chosen-word and framing-word on two adjacent lines), the exact class PR #180 called out.
findings.resolution: fixed: the framing must now be NUMERIC and co-occur with the chosen-set signal on the SAME line; the teaching doc no longer self-flags. Four co-occurrence no-FP tests added.

findings.finding: --max-grade with no value (flag last, or value dropped by an unset shell var) skipped validation and exited 0, silently disabling the gate - contradicting the documented fail-closed guarantee.
findings.resolution: fixed: a missing or flag-shaped value, and an empty --max-grade=, now exit 2. Regression tests added.

findings.finding: the 'no random' branch of CHOSEN_SET was dead (RANDOM_SET matched 'randomness' on the same window and suppressed it), so the natural phrasing of a real slip ('no randomness ... 100 percent failure rate') was missed.
findings.resolution: fixed: removed the dead branch and made RANDOM_SET affirmative-only (not preceded by no/not), so 'no randomness' no longer disarms the check. A must-flag test for the deterministic-set-as-rate slip was added.

findings.finding: wording overstated the behavior ('never flagged', 'fails closed on a non-numeric target') before the fixes.
findings.resolution: fixed: trimmed to describe the numeric + same-line rule and the missing-or-non-numeric fail-closed accurately.

findings.finding: a Then step asserted a hardcoded constant against a regex (vacuous), though the scenario was non-vacuous overall via the co-located real lint-run.
findings.resolution: fixed: removed the vacuous assertion; the real claim-lint run is the load-bearing check.
